purpose: Human reviewer decisions for the 100-record register. Read by scripts/research/corpus_pipeline.py build (pipeline 1.2.0+) and copied verbatim into reviewer_name, review_date, review_decision (the final decision), findings, appraisal_tool, reviewer_2_name, reviewer_2_decision, review_disagreement, adjudicated_by, study_type_reviewer_override, publication_date_reviewer_override and country_or_language_reviewer_promoted. Machine fields are never overwritten.
rules: Only a person who actually read the source may add an entry, and every person block needs human_attestation: true. Names of AI tools, models or automation (Claude Opus, ChatGPT, Gemini, LLM, AI agent, pipeline, ...) and template placeholders are rejected; ordinary given names such as 'Ai' or 'Claude' in a full name are accepted.

One entry per R-id. For dual review (research audit R-5) record the second, independent person in reviewer_2. When the two decisions differ, an adjudication by a third person is required and its decision is final; when they agree, leave adjudication null.
review_level is title_abstract or full_text; findings may only be recorded with a full_text review.
A full_text review must name its appraisal_tool (RoB 2, ROBINS-I, AMSTAR 2, CASP, AXIS, MMAT, ...).
publication_date_override needs the https source the date was read from (for example the publisher landing page).
Do not paste abstracts or NC/ND text into findings or notes; write the finding in your own words.

This file is an input of the frozen corpus snapshots. Before editing it, copy its current bytes to data/research/register_inputs/frozen/<snapshot>/data/research/register_inputs/reviewer_decisions.json.frozen for every snapshot whose manifest records them, then rebuild a NEW snapshot version and commit only after verify passes.
